summary: Pre-deploy polish regression pass. Backend 16/16 pytest tests green (health, quote submit with/without consent, honeypot, bad extension, contact, auth guards 401, non-admin 403, admin allowlist, admin quote lifecycle CRUD+file DL+status). Admin/quotes and admin/messages return correct shapes with the new .limit(500) cap (verified via live curl: {items:[], stats:{total,new,in_progress,quoted,closed}} and {items:[], total}). All static assets 200 via preview host: /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /favicon.png, /logo.png, /services/{laser-flat,tube-laser,waterjet,folding,powder-coating}.jpg. robots.txt contains required 'User-agent: *' + 'Disallow: /admin' + 'Sitemap:' directives (Cloudflare's managed content-signal block is prepended by the CDN but the Bernat-authored block is appended intact). sitemap.xml has all 13 <loc> URLs and is valid XML. FRONTEND desktop @1440x900: all 14 routes (/, /services, /services/{laser-cutting,tube-section-cutting,heavy-plate-profiling,folding-fabrication,finishing-secondary}, /industries, /about, /quote, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /login) render with zero runtime console errors and no ErrorBoundary fallback. Quote form desktop happy path: filled name/company/email/phone, toggled qf-process-laser-cutting, ticked qf-consent, submitted → quote-success shown with reference q_fbfd0fc7358c (cleaned up post-test). FRONTEND mobile @390x844 (viewport set BEFORE goto): tested /, /services, /services/laser-cutting, /quote, /about, /contact, /industries — every page has document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 390 exactly = viewport width, so NO horizontal scroll anywhere. Hero H1 on /: aria-label exact 'Steel, Laser Cutting & Fabrication Without the Usual Hassle.', textContent contains 'Laser Cutting\u00a0& Fabrication' (nbsp confirmed after 'Cutting'), 'Usual Hassle' still wrapped in span.text-outline-strong, H1 boundingRect.right=324 ≤ 390 (fits, no clip). Hero CTA parent computed flex-direction='column' on mobile (stacks vertically as expected from flex-col sm:flex-row). CTA section on / has computed padding-top=96px and padding-bottom=96px at 390px width (matches py-24, no longer 128px). nav-menu-toggle visible on mobile and mobile-nav opens on click. Quote page qf-process chips: 20 chips, maxRight=314 ≤ 390 — wrap cleanly without overflow. ErrorBoundary is wired inside App.js around AuthProvider and did NOT trigger on any page. Nothing broken from the polish changes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_quotes (line ~443) and list_messages (line ~513) both correctly append .limit(500) to the cursor before iteration; response shapes are unchanged and confirmed via live curl.

Hero.jsx: H1 clamp is now text-[clamp(2rem,9vw,7.5rem)] (lower floor from 2.4rem), non-breaking space in reveal span key='l1' ('Steel, Laser Cutting\u00a0'), CTA container has flex-col sm:flex-row, bottom strip has flex-col sm:flex-row + 11px mobile font — all working as intended, H1 no longer clips at 390px.
CTASection.jsx: py-24 sm:py-32 lg:py-40 — computed 96px vertical padding at 390px width, matches spec.

ErrorBoundary.jsx: standard React error boundary with getDerivedStateFromError + componentDidCatch, wraps <AuthProvider> in App.js, fallback UI ('The page hit a snag.') did not appear anywhere during the 14-route smoke.
robots.txt + sitemap.xml both served with 200; sitemap has exactly 13 valid <loc> entries covering every marketing route.
The Bernat-authored robots.txt content is intact; note the preview host's CDN prepends a Cloudflare-managed content-signal block above it (not a regression — this is CDN-injected).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14/14 desktop pages clean, 7/7 mobile pages no h-scroll, hero + CTA + nav + chips all pass)

seed_data_creation: Re-seeded admin + non-admin session tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Playwright end-to-end quote q_fbfd0fc7358c submitted and cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/quotes/{id}. Backend lifecycle test self-cleans its own TEST_ quote.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same env setup as iteration_3. Re-seed admin session with the mongosh block in /app/memory/test_credentials.md and export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest. For mobile checks, ALWAYS call page.set_viewport_size({'width':390,'height':844}) BEFORE page.goto — otherwise Tailwind sm: media queries never fire and false-positive overflow appears. Confirmed mobile invariants at 390x844: (a) no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth==innerWidth==390) on /, /services, /services/laser-cutting, /quote, /about, /contact, /industries; (b) hero H1 boundingRect.right=324 ≤ 390; (c) hero CTA parent flex-direction='column'; (d) CTASection padding 96px top/bottom (py-24). Nothing changed backend-side except .limit(500) on two admin list endpoints — response shapes unchanged.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. Pre-deploy polish (mobile-first CSS, robots.txt/sitemap.xml, ErrorBoundary wrap, .limit(500)) is fully working with zero regressions.
